observer_effect_and_limits: No preventDefault, stopPropagation, handler wrapping/invocation, state setters, focus change, coordinates, synthetic product events, or extra native keys. Only DOM reads, listeners, and mutation observation.
Six synchronous event-boundary reads and mutation callbacks add small execution overhead and can perturb a timing-sensitive race; no native run has validated observer effect.
React handler entry and setOpen/onOpenChange calls are NOT measured. DOM React prop presence cannot prove handler execution or identify a suppression source.
Listeners register after product listeners; stopImmediatePropagation can hide an entire boundary. Missing callbacks localize an interval, not the precise listener.
MutationObserver state snapshots read callback-time state; oldStateWasOpen captures attribute old values, not React state. A React false/true update batched without DOM changes remains invisible.
Trace attaches to the originally found dialog; replacement nodes are not reattached. Original removal plus final open count distinguishes replacement as a next investigation lead.
At most 32 event records and 32 mutation records, each path limited to 16 fixed-vocabulary DOM shapes; truncation counters explicit. No text/HTML/URLs/ids/classes/credentials stored.
Happy DOM tests use untrusted event simulation and are observer guards only, not native or product verification.
Existing driver tests mock the observer external dependency for their synthetic DOM; separate tests execute exact serialized observer expression and real DOM event propagation.
No user-visible behavior changed, so no feature-test instruction change needed. Root retains defect/inventory/COORD ownership.
